heading: What we do
intro: Girls Who Code @ Columbia is a tech and mentorship community with a dual mission:

missions.text: To empower NYC high school girls through mentorship & outreach
To support Columbia students with leadership, growth, and community

closing: We don’t just teach code—we build confidence, foster long-term relationships, and create real pathways into tech for young women.
